title: IngestBatchesResponse
description: POST /v1/ingest/batches response. 200 = all accepted; 207 = partial acceptance; rejected items must be retried or dead-lettered.

accepted.description: Event ids accepted by the target.

head.description: sha256:<hex> of the anchored head after this ingest, when applicable.

tier.description: Tier this ingest was recorded under. T2 must be absent until G-4.2 approval.
